design_vision: Premium, modern, and fluid e-commerce site for KÔYA Market. Blending high-end editorial aesthetics with the vibrant, natural richness of Afro-Caribbean culture. Avoids clichés by using elegant typography, generous negative space, and a refined palette of dark green and orange.

headings.usage_rules: Use slightly bold (500/600) for H1/H2. Keep letter spacing tight (tracking-tight). Avoid generic sans.

body.usage_rules: Thin and design aesthetics. Use 300 (light) or 400 (regular) for body copy. Loose line height (leading-relaxed).

spacing_and_layout.general_rule: Generous spacing. Use p-8 to p-16 for section padding. Containers must have internal padding to avoid text collision.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Use bento grid for the About Us and Features sections. Product grids should use 4 columns on desktop (grid-cols-4) with gap-6. Mobile-first (grid-cols-1 or 2).
spacing_and_layout.borders_and_radius: Subtle roundness. rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-full for buttons. Use 1px borders (border-border) instead of heavy drop shadows for a premium flat look.

components.hero: Requires a delivery zone checker (input + submit button). Overlay the hero image with bg-black/30 or gradient to transparent to ensure text contrast while letting the image breathe.
components.product_card: Cardless or flat surface look. Large high-quality image container. Quick add-to-cart button that appears on hover.
components.recipe_card: Immersive image. Portion adjuster component (Shadcn Stepper/Input) that updates ingredient lists dynamically.
components.buttons: Primary CTA in Vibrant Orange. Secondary actions in Dark Green or subtle outline.
components.navigation: Sticky header with crystal glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-border/40). Minimalist links.
components.chatbot: Floating action button in the bottom right, using Phosphor Icons or Lucide.
components.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (Duotone) for a high-end look.

motion.hover: Images subtly scale up (hover:scale-105 duration-300). Buttons lift slightly (hover:-translate-y-1).
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-in for product grids. Smooth scrolling utilizing Lenis.

image_urls.description: Premium grocery delivery bag in store, smiling woman.
Black woman following recipe on tablet in modern kitchen.
Modern kitchen illuminated by warm sunset light, depicting organic lifestyle.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: MANDATORY on all interactive elements (e.g. data-testid='delivery-zone-input', data-testid='add-to-cart-btn').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text contrast on primary/secondary buttons meets APCA guidelines. If vibrant orange fails contrast with white text, switch text to dark stone (#1C1917).
